name: starlight_snare_enchanted_creature_does_not_untap
notes: P83c04d814c G4. Printed: 'Enchant creature. When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.' Seat 0 casts Starlight Snare on seat 1's untapped 2/2: it is attached and the 2/2 is tapped. Seat 1's next untap step (advance_turn) untaps seat 1's other tapped creature but not the enchanted one.
